name: Mesh Exporter
author: Modly
description: Exports the mesh to a chosen format (GLB, STL, OBJ, PLY) at a specified output path.

params_schema.label: Name this model (optional)
params_schema.description: Used for the file name, e.g. 'brass floor lamp' becomes brass-floor-lamp-4f2a.glb. Leave it blank for a dated name.

params_schema.label: Which game or project is this for? (optional)
params_schema.description: Files are filed under a folder of this name, so the Library groups a game's models together instead of one long list.

params_schema.label: Tags (optional, comma separated)
params_schema.description: Saved with the model. The exporter adds what it can tell on its own — rigged, animated, textured, how heavy it is.

params_schema.label: Output Path
params_schema.tooltip: Destination folder. Leave empty to save in the workspace Exports folder.
